name: Sister Deprived
source:
The story of a first-year student who grew up in love with Nanami, who was like a sister to him, protected him from bullies, made his lunch, helped him, even lived with him, only to give her most precious thing to someone else! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE097875.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个大一新生的故事——他从小就爱着像姐姐一样的七海，她保护他不被欺负，给他做便当，帮助他，甚至和他住在一起，却把她最珍贵的东西献给了别人！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE097875.html]DLsite English[/url]]
